_about: Public-domain Christmas Evans (1766-1838, Welsh Baptist preacher) for the Word Hoard: his Sermons in the 1857 Philadelphia edition (a new translation from the Welsh, with a memoir by Joseph Cross; Project Gutenberg), plus three biographies by other hands: Edwin Paxton Hood's Christmas Evans, the Preacher of Wild Wales (PG, 1888 text), David Rhys Stephen's Memoirs (1847) and D. Phillips's Memoir (catalogued 1843). Evans wrote in Welsh; the translator of the sermons is not named on the title page as read, so none is claimed. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

evans-sermons: Sermons of Christmas Evans: A New Translation from the Welsh, with a Memoir and Portraiture of the Author by Joseph Cross (Philadelphia: Leary & Getz, 1857)
evans-hood-life: Christmas Evans, the Preacher of Wild Wales, by Edwin Paxton Hood (biography; transcribed from the London: Hodder and Stoughton 3rd ed., 1888)

evans-stephen-memoirs: Memoirs of the Late Christmas Evans, of Wales, by David Rhys Stephen (biography; London: Aylott and Jones, 1847)
evans-phillips-memoir: Memoir of the Life, Labors, and Extensive Usefulness of the Rev. Christmas Evans, by D. Phillips (biography; catalogued New York: M. W. Dodd, 1843)

_alternates.evans-sermons-scan: Sermons, same Cross edition, scan (IA cu31924032172466); also Richmond: John Early, 1850 (IA sermonsofchristm01evan)
